verdicts.text: Kubernetes is evolving to support AI through GPU-aware scheduling and more advanced workload orchestration.

Per CIO, DRA lets apps "specify the properties they need—GPU type, memory capacity, interconnect topology — and let the scheduler find the optimal placement." Kubernetes v1.36 also added workload-aware scheduling: PodGroups, topology-aware scheduling and workload-aware preemption.
verdicts.framing_note: A general trend claim with no source cited. It matches well-documented upstream Kubernetes work (DRA, workload-aware scheduling), but the evidence comes from secondary sources, not kubernetes.io release notes.
